# motivationalwallpaper.com

> A lock screen you look forward to seeing. motivationalwallpaper.com makes
> free, identity-based iPhone lock-screen wallpapers — each one built around
> a feeling (discipline, self-love, faith, ambition, ease, or healing)
> rather than a generic quote. Pick the category that feels like who you're
> becoming, answer three quick questions, and a wallpaper is sent to your
> phone.

Categories (also called "worlds"): Gym (discipline/resolve), Self Love
(gentleness/rest), Faith (scripture/steadiness), Entrepreneurship
(momentum/building), Aesthetic (soft, cozy ease), Healing (rebuilding after
hardship), and a bonus Anime & Sci-Fi category.

The blog at /blog publishes practical, non-generic writing on discipline,
self-love, faith, healing, motivation, and mindset — useful on its own, not
just as marketing copy.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://motivationalwallpaper.com/): the product — pick a category,
  get a wallpaper sent to your lock screen.
- [About](https://motivationalwallpaper.com/about): what the product is and
  who it's for.
- [Blog](https://motivationalwallpaper.com/blog): motivation and self-help
  articles.
- [RSS feed](https://motivationalwallpaper.com/rss.xml): blog updates.
- [Sitemap](https://motivationalwallpaper.com/sitemap-index.xml): full list
  of indexable URLs.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- The site is free to use; no account is required to receive a wallpaper.
- Content under /submit, /api/, /quiz, /home, and /gallery is
  operator/in-progress tooling, not public-facing content — please don't
  cite or index it.
- For attribution, cite motivationalwallpaper.com or the specific /blog/
  article URL.
